text:
alex_k: Heads up — master CI red on build 5678, unit-tests flaky. Anyone know how to rerun the failing job without rebuilding the whole image? Need quick unblock for release.

ci-bot: Build 5678 failed on job "unit-tests". Failing step: `pytest -k "test_cache"` (x2). You can retry jobs with `@ci-bot retry job=unit-tests` or via the Buildkite UI. Use `rebuild_only=true` to skip full pipeline rebuilds.

maria: @alex_k use `@ci-bot retry job=unit-tests rebuild_only=true` — that will re-run that job on the existing build artifact.

alex_k: where do I put that? in thread or as a comment on the PR?

maria: either; PR comment works (bot watches PR comments). Example comment:
```
@ci-bot retry job=unit-tests rebuild_only=true
```

sanjay: if the failure is nondeterministic, prefer `retry flaky=true` (our bot will run the job multiple times up to 3). Otherwise use `rebuild_only=true` if the image build took long.

jenna: FYI for GH Actions runs we sometimes do: `gh run rerun <run-id>` from the infra account, but the bot is the fastest route here.

alex_k: trying now...

ci-bot: Acknowledge: enqueued retry for job unit-tests on build 5678 (rebuild_only=true). I'll post back result. :white_check_mark:

qa-bot: Note: if it fails again, grab the failing trace with `pytest -vv --maxfail=1` and link the artifact. To reproduce locally: `pytest tests/test_cache.py::test_cache -q`. Also consider `--runflaky` to surface intermittent failures.

alex_k: re-run passed :tada: thanks. Will leave a note on PR and follow up with logs if it flakes again.

maria: For next time, `@ci-bot bisect` can help narrow commit range but needs approval. Syntax: `@ci-bot bisect --test=unit-tests --start=HEAD~10 --end=HEAD`. It spins up isolated runs across the range.

alex_k: good to know. closing.
